zh-TW.name: 九宵
zh-TW.title: Canis Den
zh-TW.description: 嗷嗷，這裡有九宵的創作、社群、履歷、合作邀約與各種重要入口。想找作品、追蹤近況，或丟一顆合作飛盤，都可以從這裡開始🐶
zh-TW.metadataDescription: 歡迎來到九宵的可愛犬窩！一站找到作品、日常動態、社群連結與合作邀約，跟著犬爪探索最新內容 🐾

en.name: Canis
en.title: Canis Den
en.description: Awooo, this is the official link hub for Canis: work, socials, collaborations, and latest updates. Find my works, follow my socials, or throw a collaboration frisbee here 🐶
en.metadataDescription: Welcome to Canis Den! Follow the paw prints to discover my creations, daily updates, socials, and collaboration links 🐾

description.zh-TW: 記錄日常生活、個人近況與隨手分享的 Instagram 主帳，想看看鏡頭外的九宵就從這裡開始。
description.en: My main Instagram for everyday life, personal updates, and casual moments. Start here for a look at Canis beyond the screen.

description.zh-TW: 以人型犬身分與生活為主的 Instagram，收著更多可愛、貼近真實自我與個人風格的照片和近況。
description.en: My Instagram as an anthropomorphic dog, sharing photos, everyday updates, and a more personal look at who I am.

description.zh-TW: 以人型犬身分分享成人向與敏感題材的 X 帳號，僅適合已年滿 18 歲並願意接觸相關內容的訪客。
description.en: My adult and sensitive-content X account as an anthropomorphic dog. Intended only for visitors aged 18 or older who choose to view it.

description.zh-TW: 公開分享日常想法、作品進度、科技話題與即時近況的 X 主帳，適合快速追蹤最近動態。
description.en: My main X account for quick thoughts, project progress, technology topics, and real-time updates.

description.zh-TW: 在 Bump 上查看我的個人檔案與社群足跡，從地圖與個人頁面探索更多公開資訊和連結。
description.en: View my Bump profile and social trail, with a map-based profile that brings together more public details and links.

description.zh-TW: 前往我的 Discord 邀請入口，適合即時聊天、交流近況，或用比較輕鬆的方式和我打聲招呼。
description.en: Use this Discord invite to chat, catch up, or say hello in a more casual and real-time space.

description.zh-TW: 我的一般向 Threads，分享生活碎片、隨手短文與社群互動，適合輕鬆看看最近在想什麼。
description.en: My general Threads profile for everyday snippets, short posts, and casual conversations about whatever is on my mind.

description.zh-TW: 以人型犬身分分享生活與個人風格的 Threads，集中記錄日常、短篇近況與更貼近真實自我的一面。
description.en: My Threads profile as an anthropomorphic dog, sharing everyday life, short updates, and a more personal side of my identity.

description.zh-TW: 我的 Facebook 個人頁面，收錄較完整的公開身分、生活紀錄與社群動態，方便認識和保持聯繫。
description.en: My Facebook profile with public identity details, life updates, and social activity for staying connected.

description.zh-TW: 在 Retro 上保存與朋友共享的生活照片和回憶，用比較安靜、以影像為主的方式記錄日常。
description.en: My Retro profile for saving and sharing everyday photos and memories with friends in a quieter, photo-first space.

description.zh-TW: Infinity 資訊的工作室網站，介紹網站開發、電腦相關服務與我的專業入口，也是認識工作內容的起點。
description.en: The Infinity Studio website, introducing my web development, computer-related services, and professional work.

description.zh-TW: 整理技術文章、開發筆記與實作紀錄的個人部落格，保存解題過程，也分享一路累積的經驗。
description.en: My personal blog for technical articles, development notes, implementation records, and lessons learned along the way.

description.zh-TW: 完整整理前端、後端、資料庫與開發工具技能，以及工作經歷、個人工作室背景和作品集的雙語履歷。
description.en: A bilingual resume covering front-end, back-end, databases, development tools, work experience, studio background, and portfolio.

description.zh-TW: 查看我的開源專案、程式碼與技術實驗，包含主題、前端作品、部落格等持續維護中的 repositories。
description.en: Explore my open-source projects, code, and technical experiments, including themes, front-end work, and blog-related repositories.

description.zh-TW: 我的 LinkedIn 專業檔案，集中呈現職涯經歷、技能與工作身分，適合商務合作與職場交流。
description.en: My LinkedIn profile for professional experience, skills, and career identity, suitable for business and industry connections.

description.zh-TW: 我的 LINE 貼圖商店！

title.zh-TW: 汪の表情日記｜LINE 貼圖

description.zh-TW: 從開心到委屈、從害羞到色色（欸），狗系少年的一天，用 24 張可愛表情說出你的小情緒！搭配可愛又有點欠摸的臉蛋，快把「汪の表情日記」帶回家，讓牠陪你度過每一刻吧！
description.en: 24 moods of a puppy boy! From happy and shy to spicy and sleepy--'Pup's Mood Diary' says what you feel, so you don't have to!
